verdict.line: You outlane and out-duel Urgot through level 9, but the measured 40.7% win rate over 91 games says that lead evaporates if you let Urgot's build and ultimate come online past 20 minutes.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has the tools to force this fight: Q's (Ntofo Strikes) two-stack shockwave pulls Urgot out of his comfortable poke range, and E (Footwork) gives a dash-shield to close whenever Urgot's E (Disdain) is down. The data's solo-kill and lane advantage both point your way early, but the 40.7% head-to-head win rate shows those individual wins aren't converting into game wins once Urgot's W (Purge) cooldown collapses toward 0s and his global R (Fear Beyond Death, range 2500) starts threatening executions. Treat this as a lane you should dominate, but a game you need to end, not stall.

theirWindow.what: He can poke freely with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, slows on hit) and still has the tool to fling you away with E (Disdain, 16-14s cooldown) if you commit to a dash. Don't walk your E (Footwork) or W (Path Maker) charge into him while this is up — you'll just get flung off and eat the full trade for nothing.

yourWindow.what: All-in immediately. Close with E (Footwork)'s dash-shield or land a second Q (Ntofo Strikes) hit for the two-stack shockwave pull, then lock him in place with W (Path Maker)'s charge-dash stun — he has nothing left to create separation with.

start.why: Paired with a Health Potion, this is the clearly better-performing start (43.5% WR over 85 games, 84.2% pick) and gives the sustain to keep trading into Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) poke.

boots.why: The dominant pick (86.7%) and best-sampled result (38.8% WR over 85 games) — reduces the sting of Urgot's auto-attacks and W (Purge) unload during extended trades.

core.why: Common first item across every recorded build path; the slow-on-hit lets you actually stick to Urgot after you close distance with Q or E.
Part of the best-performing recorded path (75% WR over 4 games) into Spirit Visage — stacks resistances for the extended skirmishes this matchup tends to produce.
Completes the top win-rate path; the healing amp matters since you're relying on repeated all-ins, not one clean burst, to win fights.
Listed among the common later items — the active and attack-speed slow directly blunts Urgot's W (Purge) unload once his cooldown collapses.

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's sustained trading power and max-health scaling matches the repeated-engagement pattern here — you're not winning with one burst trade, you're winning by re-closing distance on Urgot over and over per wave.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the standard pick (76.9% pick rate) for wave management and map pressure, but Flash+Ignite actually shows the higher measured win rate (44.4% over a smaller sample) if you want to lean into the solo-kill advantage and end the lane outright rather than scale.

playing.title: Punish missing E (Disdain)
playing.detail: The instant Urgot's E (Disdain, 16-14s cooldown) is down — baited on a wave or already used — engage with E (Footwork)'s dash-shield. He has no tool left to create distance.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range Q poke
playing.detail: Before level 3, you have no answer to Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, slows). Stay behind minions rather than eating free poke with nothing to punish it.

playing.title: Chain Q stacks into the pull
playing.detail: Q (Ntofo Strikes) grants a stack on hit; the second stack fires a shockwave that pulls Urgot in. Use this the moment he's already marked to erase his range advantage.

playing.title: All-in before wave 3
playing.detail: You have the solo-kill advantage in this data — press it early rather than passively farming, since your lane edge shrinks as his build comes online.

playing.title: Save R for wall combos
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks Urgot back and launches him through any wall in his path. Fight near river or tribrush walls from level 6 on so the knockback converts into a real kill threat.

playing.title: Shorten trades once W ranks up
playing.detail: Once Urgot's W (Purge) reaches rank 3-5, its cooldown drops from 6s toward 0s, letting him unload repeatedly. Hit, disengage with E (Footwork), and reset rather than slugging it out past level 10.

playing.title: Close the game before 25 minutes
playing.detail: The 40.7% win rate over 91 games means lane wins aren't translating to game wins — convert your early kills into objectives and TP plays rather than letting Urgot scale into his R (Fear Beyond Death, 2500 range) execute threat.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and every win-rate/pick-rate figure above come from measured K'Sante vs Urgot games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, trade windows, and tactical framing are my own analysis.
